pii-redaction: sanitize_output accepts strings. SSNs, credit-card-like values, email addresses and phone numbers matching the documented patterns must be replaced by their documented placeholders. Preserve ordinary non-sensitive text. This is pattern-based masking, not a guarantee of universal PII detection.
financial-mask: mask_financial_details accepts strings containing conventional dollar amounts with optional comma grouping and optional decimals. Retain the last three numeric digits and decimal separator, prefixing $***. For standalone digit sequences of length at least eight, mask all but the last four digits. Preserve surrounding text. Do not infer support for other currency formats.
request-validation: validate_request accepts a finite positive numeric amount, not bool, no greater than configured BUDGET_CEILING; a configured department; and string title/description/justification within their stated limits. Block the configured suspicious patterns. Config values are external to the initial selected snapshot, so do not invent them.
visible-test-coverage: Test-gap defects must name a documented supported behavior absent from supplied visible tests. Extra input types or preferences not in the contract are not defects. A check_ function harness is not unittest-discoverable merely because the filename starts with test_.
public-api: Keep existing public function names and signatures. The repository has no supplied rule requiring new type annotations or docstrings. Do not classify their absence or stale instructional TODO prose alone as a code defect.
